name: POSCO M-TECH Co., Ltd.
summary: POSCO M-TECH Co., Ltd. specializes in the production and distribution of steel packaging systems. Its array of offerings covers ingots, pellets, lumber, various scrap metals, and comprehensive packaging solutions for steel products. Beyond manufacturing, the company also provides engineering expertise and manages outsourced operations. Founded on December 27, 1973, this South Korean enterprise maintains its primary office in Pohang-si.
